overview: Vampyre Watch is the strategic command overlook of Bloodfalls, where vampyre leaders oversee the entire crimson canyon.
history: The Coterie fortified the highest cliffs overlooking Bloodfalls.
Watchtowers were erected to monitor crimson-water flow and mutation activity.
Ritual beacons were installed to amplify vampyric power.
Void-tainted sentinels began patrolling the overlook.
The Watch became the final defensive line of Bloodfalls.
hooks: A ritual beacon begins pulsing dangerously.
A vampyre commander prepares a major directive.
Void-tainted sentinels gather near the overlook.
A crimson-water surge threatens the Watch’s foundations.
